sources.name: Michigan MCDA Local Area Unemployment Statistics
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
sources.methodology_notes: Residence-based estimates of people; not payroll job counts.

sources.name: Michigan MCDA Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
sources.methodology_notes: Primarily based on employers covered by unemployment-insurance laws; employment is payroll employment.

sources.name: Michigan MCDA Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
sources.methodology_notes: Snapshot estimates. Michigan MCDA cautions against treating OEWS estimates as a simple year-to-year time series.

sources.name: Michigan Employment Projections
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
sources.methodology_notes: Current catalog includes statewide and regional 2024-2034 long-term projections.

sources.name: Michigan Online Job Advertisements / Help Wanted Online
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Data and Analytics
sources.methodology_notes: Advertisements are not identical to unique vacancies or hires; deduplication and carry-over methodology must be preserved.

sources.name: MI School Data
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Educational Performance and Information
sources.methodology_notes: Michigan official public education-data portal. Baseline ingest is aggregate/public only.

sources.name: Student Transcript and Academic Record Repository (STARR)
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Educational Performance and Information
sources.methodology_notes: Student-level source collection is restricted; use public aggregate outputs unless separately authorized.

sources.name: Michigan Statewide Longitudinal Data System
sources.publisher: Michigan Center for Educational Performance and Information
sources.methodology_notes: Centralized education repository; public access is through aggregate reports.

sources.name: Michigan Workforce Longitudinal Data System
sources.publisher: Michigan Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity
sources.methodology_notes: Links education and workforce data; use aggregate published products unless separately authorized.

sources.name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API v2
sources.methodology_notes: Series semantics vary by BLS program; series metadata and survey identity must be retained.

sources.name: Census Quarterly Workforce Indicators API
sources.methodology_notes: QWI provides longitudinal employer-household indicators. Current Census developer guidance requires an API key.

sources.name: Census LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES)
sources.methodology_notes: Useful for residence-workplace flows; release/version and geography vintage must be preserved.

sources.name: Census Post-Secondary Employment Outcomes
sources.methodology_notes: Coverage depends on participating institutions/states and release; preserve coverage metadata.

sources.name: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System
sources.methodology_notes: Store survey component/year and provisional/final status where available.

sources.name: O*NET Database and Web Services
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor O*NET Program
sources.methodology_notes: Persist O*NET database release and O*NET-SOC taxonomy version.

sources.name: Registered Apprenticeship Data and Statistics
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Labor Office of Apprenticeship
sources.methodology_notes: Public dashboards are based on RAPIDS/state workload data; preserve data-through date and state notes.
